Cause: browser/HF cached old `style.css` + `app.js`. New HTML classes match nothing in old CSS → unstyled page; old JS errored on missing elements → spinners stuck.

Fixes:
1. `style.css?v=2` / `app.js?v=2` — cache-bust
2. `NoCacheStaticFiles` wrapper — `Cache-Control: no-cache, must-revalidate` on all static files, so future deploys never go stale

Re-upload all 4 files to Space (`app.py`, `static/index.html`, `static/style.css`, `static/app.js`), then hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) once. After that, normal refresh fine.
